flags.t: Spot is inside an ATV (all terrain vehicle) for Hunting Closed Area: South Chilcotin and M.U. 5-14. Closed between 4:00 a.m. and 10:00 a.m. from September 1 to November 30. Synopsis map 4-2/23.

plan: Drive: from Chilanko Forks, about 93 km (straight line times 1.3, estimate). Via Hwy 20 (Chilcotin-Bella Coola Hwy 20), Big Stick Rec Site FSR. Official directions to Big Stick Lake rec site: Approximately 39 km northwest of Tatla Lake on Hwy 20, turn left/west onto the Big Stick Forest Service Road.
Park: 52.01687, -125.09396, the rec site. Map links below.

R5C-camp-camp-0001.recDirections: Approximately 39 km northwest of Tatla Lake on Hwy 20, turn left/west onto the Big Stick Forest Service Road. Travel 200 meters to the top of the hill and turn left. Travel 9.9 km to the Big Stick Lake Recreation Site, keeping right at approximately 4.2 km. Sections of the road can be narrow and rough, so a 4x4 vehicle is recommended and large travel trailers may have difficulty accessing the site.
